entries.note: The drafter adds the specific interpretation of a replacement growth driver. “Nothing left afterwards” does not specify what would be absent sufficiently to support a shared test.

entries.test: Public stock-market prices and event analyses showing whether an AI bubble collapse causes a measurable loss in market value.
entries.note: The surrounding paragraph supplies the AI bubble collapse as the condition; no deadline is stated.

entries.test: Public layoff announcements, employment statistics, and reporting showing whether an AI bubble collapse causes tens of thousands of job losses.
entries.note: The condition is supplied by context, and the predicted job losses have a concrete numerical scale.

entries.test: Public technology-sector employment, revenue, investment, and business-failure data showing whether an AI bubble collapse begins a severe, sustained sector-wide contraction.
entries.note: “Depression” has a plain economic reading as a severe, sustained downturn despite lacking a numerical threshold.
